meta.source: Election Commission of India — voters.eci.gov.in; National Voters' Service Portal (NVSP)

disqualifications: Person convicted of election offenses within 6 years
eligibility_criteria.source: Constitution of India — Article 326; RPA 1951 — Sections 16–19

registration_steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
registration_steps.desc: You must be 18+ years old on January 1st of the election year and an Indian citizen. Overseas Indian Citizens (OCI) are NOT eligible. NRIs who are Indian citizens CAN register.

registration_steps.title: Check Your Existing Registration
registration_steps.desc: Before applying, check if you're already registered at electoralsearch.eci.gov.in using your name + date of birth + state. Also check via the Voter Helpline App or by calling 1950.

registration_steps.title: Fill the Correct Form

forms.use: New voter registration (first time, or moved from another constituency)
Objection to inclusion of someone else's name, or deletion of dead voter
Correction of entries in voter roll (name spelling, photo, age, etc.)
Transposition (shifting of entry) within the same constituency on address change

registration_steps.desc: All forms are available on voters.eci.gov.in and at the Booth Level Officer (BLO) in your area.

registration_steps.title: Submit Online or at BLO
registration_steps.app: Voter Helpline App (Google Play / Apple App Store)
registration_steps.offline: Submit physical form to Booth Level Officer (BLO) or Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) of your constituency
registration_steps.desc: Online submission is fastest. After submission, you get a reference number to track status. BLO will verify your address within 30 days.
registration_steps.source: ECI Digital India Initiative; NVSP Portal

required.doc: Proof of Age (Aadhaar / Birth Certificate / School Certificate / Passport)
Proof of Residence (Aadhaar / Utility bill / Bank statement / Ration card)

optional.doc: Aadhaar Card (if available — for EPIC linking)

registration_steps.title: Track and Download e-EPIC
registration_steps.desc: After verification (typically 30 days), download your e-EPIC (digital Voter ID) from voters.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline App. The e-EPIC is a valid PDF voter ID accepted at polling booths.

common_issues.solution: Check electoralsearch.eci.gov.in. Apply via Form 6. Call 1950. On election day request Tender Ballot from Presiding Officer.
Apply via Form 8 (Correction) at voters.eci.gov.in or at BLO office. Corrections free of charge.
Apply Form 6 for new constituency. Also submit Form 7 to delete from old constituency.
Download e-EPIC free from voters.eci.gov.in using EPIC number. Or apply for duplicate EPIC at ERO.
